title: Backend profile capability seed (backend-runtime-v1)
description: Shape of a single named profile JSON file under BACKEND_HOME/profiles/<name>.json (or BRAIN_PROFILES_DIR). Profiles are backend-neutral capability bundles consumed by Brain RPC host authorization. Version 1 requires seeds for admin and contributor. Hermes-Lanyard is the reference implementation; seed files are not Hermes product-private formats. Portal must display and model these as backend profiles (never Hermes-only labels).

schema_version.description: Profile document schema major. Bump only with breaking changes to this file's shape.

name.description: Stable profile identifier. File basename without .json must match name (e.g. profiles/admin.json → name admin). v1 required names: admin, contributor. Additional names are allowed for multi-pipeline SOWs but must be declared on the artifact manifest capabilities.profiles list.

role.description: Optional role label (often identical to name). Informational for operators; authorization uses name + capabilities.

description.description: Human-readable summary for operators and deploy docs.

workdir.description: Optional default working directory for agent file tools when the profile is active. Empty string means use backend defaults. Relative paths are backend-defined; not a vault ACL.

path_prefixes.description: Optional vault-root-relative path prefix defaults for this seed. See x-lanyard-path-acl for normative runtime behavior. Empty array in a contributor seed means Portal (or control-plane roles) supplies path_prefixes on the auth subject at request time. Admin seeds typically use ["/"] or empty with vault_full for full vault.

capabilities.description: Capability strings granted when a request subject selects this profile. Host loads the seed for the named profile and intersects method requirements (any-of). Unknown profile names with no seed fail closed.

enforced_by.description: Optional provenance tag for who wrote/enforced the seed (e.g. platform-bootstrap, backend-builtin). Not used for authorization.

display_name.description: Optional Portal-facing label. Prefer backend-neutral wording (e.g. "Administrator", "Contributor"). Do not use product-branded labels such as "Hermes admin".

capabilityString.description: Snake_case capability token. v1 catalog is documented under x-lanyard-capability-catalog; additional tokens may be used by a backend but Portal feature gates should only rely on catalogued ones.

vaultPathPrefix.description: Vault-root-relative POSIX prefix starting with /. No .. segments. Examples: /, /Projects/Legal, /Knowledge.

x-lanyard-capability-catalog.description: v1 capability tokens used by host profile seeds and Brain RPC method gates. Artifact-level method lists remain on the manifest; this catalog is the profile authorization vocabulary.

tokens.vault_read: Read vault metadata and file bodies via Brain RPC vault.* (list/stat/read) and related read paths.
tokens.vault_write: Write vault content when vault.write (or equivalent) is implemented and allowed for the subject path.
tokens.vault_full: Unrestricted vault path ACL when auth subject path_prefixes is empty; implies admin-class vault access. Admin only in the baseline matrix.
tokens.chat: Participate in relay chat sessions under this profile.
tokens.profile_manage: Manage host profiles / RBAC seeds. Admin only.
tokens.system_ops: Host system operations tools. Admin only.
tokens.shell_exec: Execute shell/tool children with elevated host impact. Admin only.
tokens.gateway_config: Mutate gateway/runtime configuration surfaces. Admin only.
tokens.beads_admin: Administrative issue-tracker / beads operations. Admin only.

x-lanyard-path-acl.description: Normative vault path prefix ACL for Brain RPC vault path methods (vault.list, vault.stat, vault.read, vault.write, …). Paths are always vault-root-relative (relative to VAULT_ROOT), not absolute host paths.
path_shape: Must be a non-empty string starting with /
Strip trailing slash except for root /
Result looks absolute (leading /) but is resolved under VAULT_ROOT only

runtime_sources.host_seed: BACKEND_HOME/profiles/<name>.json (or BRAIN_PROFILES_DIR). Supplies capabilities for the named profile and optional default path_prefixes.
runtime_sources.auth_subject: Brain RPC auth.subject carries the active profile name and the effective path_prefixes for the session. Portal/control-plane roles stamp path_prefixes; the host re-checks fail-closed.

path_allowed_rules: If the loaded profile capabilities include vault_full AND the subject path_prefixes list is empty → allow every vault path (admin full-vault shortcut).
If subject path_prefixes is empty and vault_full is absent → deny all vault path operations (contributor must receive prefixes from Portal).
If any subject prefix is / → allow every vault path.
Otherwise allow when the normalized vault path equals a prefix or starts with prefix + "/".
Directory listings must filter child entries that fail path_allowed.
Methods without path ACL (e.g. brain.ping, brain.health, settings.snapshot) still require valid auth but skip path_allowed.
x-lanyard-path-acl.seed_vs_session: Host seed path_prefixes document defaults and may be used by deploy tooling; session enforcement uses auth.subject.path_prefixes after capability load. Portal cannot elevate a session beyond the host profile capability matrix; host seeds cannot invent Portal role membership.

x-lanyard-terminology.description: Portal-facing and platform field names must stay backend-neutral.

preferred.profile: Backend profile (named capability bundle: admin, contributor, …)
preferred.backend_profile: Preferred control-plane / auth field for the profile name
preferred.path_prefixes: Vault-root-relative ACL prefixes on the role or auth subject

legacy_aliases.hermes_profile: Historical Portal/control-plane field and Hermes-Lanyard auth.subject key. Accept as alias of backend_profile during migration; new Portal UI copy and APIs must not say Hermes profile.
legacy_aliases.HERMES_HOME/profiles/: Hermes-compatible alias of BACKEND_HOME/profiles when HERMES_HOME=$BACKEND_HOME.

portal_rules: Display profiles as backend profiles, not Hermes profiles.
Do not hard-code Hermes-only profile product names in UI strings.
Map tenant roles → backend_profile + path_prefixes; stamp both on Brain RPC auth.
Feature-gate ops UI on host capabilities (e.g. profile_manage), not on backend kind.

files.admin.json: Required v1 seed (or documented builtin equivalent)
files.contributor.json: Required v1 seed (or documented builtin equivalent)

resolution_order: Builtin admin/contributor capability map packaged with the backend (fallback only)
